findings.source_quote: While a few gay tunes, such as Winter Wonderland, seek to capitalize upon its majestic moments, winter is generally despised by the normal inhabitants of this earth.
findings.suggested_fix: Either transliterate or translate the song title into Korean for consistency with the rest of the prose, or add a parenthetical Korean rendering. findings.translation_quote: Winter Wonderland와 같은 몇몇 경쾌한 곡조들이 그 장엄한 순간을 이용하려 하지만, 겨울은 일반적으로 이 땅의 평범한 거주자들에게 경멸받는다.
